caseName: Commodities Trading Corp. v. United States
caseNameFull: Commodities Trading Corp. v. United States and United States v. Commodities Trading Corp., ante, p. 121 and Railway Labor Executives' Association v. United States, ante, p. 142

opinions.text:
The petitions for rehearing in these cases are severally denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
